home.title: Yagmur Şimşek Sönmez — Product Designer
home.description: Portfolio of Yagmur Şimşek Sönmez, Berlin-based product designer and UX researcher. Shipped iOS apps, usability research and design systems.

healthbar.title: HealthBar — Yagmur Şimşek Sönmez
healthbar.description: HealthBar: an RPG-style Apple Health companion for iOS and Apple Watch. UX/UI case study: dashboard comprehension rose from 44% to 89% in usability tests.

ikeep.title: iKeep — Yagmur Şimşek Sönmez
ikeep.description: iKeep: a copy and paste vault, live on the App Store. Product design case study from information architecture to light and dark UI, built in one week.

playmate.title: PlayMate — Yagmur Şimşek Sönmez
playmate.description: PlayMate: a community-driven sports matchmaking iOS app. Case study with user interviews, moderated usability testing and information architecture.

kitbox.title: Kitbox — Yagmur Şimşek Sönmez
kitbox.description: Kitbox: a mobile e-commerce app for a home-goods brand, live on the App Store. UX/UI case study on the design system, onboarding and 3-step checkout.

ai-claim.title: AI Claim Copilot — Yagmur Şimşek Sönmez
ai-claim.description: AI Claim Copilot: filing an insurance claim in 3 minutes, with AI. An iOS product design challenge covering the product concept, user flow and screens.

pagepals.title: PagePals — Yagmur Şimşek Sönmez
pagepals.description: PagePals: a social, gamified reading platform. UX case study covering survey research, information architecture and a design system.

urban-sports-vs-classpass.title: Urban Sports vs ClassPass — Yagmur Şimşek Sönmez
urban-sports-vs-classpass.description: A task-based comparative UX study of Urban Sports Club vs ClassPass on iOS: class discovery, venue selection and booking, based on a heuristic review.

bubbles.title: Bubbles — Yagmur Şimşek Sönmez
bubbles.description: Bubbles: a task manager for iOS. Case study in progress.
